draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.19, the 96th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 11th of 27 at CB. He lasted until pick 158, well after his grade rank (96th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: James Bradberry. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 4 passes defended in 2019, 23rd of 27 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the Houston Texans (practice squad). 40 career games and 26 starts over 5 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2024 against a career-best 5 in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (2nd percentile). Played 1 of 17 games in 2024. Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 1.5% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, below the norm.
